rows.text: divides `edx` by the result of `00184950()` (signed `idiv`) and adds 1; when `ecx` is non-negative (signed) and `002F16B0()` returns a non-null record, stores dword 0 at `+0`, that quotient plus 1 at dword `+4`, the address `00361080` at qword `+8`, qword 0 at `+0x10`, dword `0x10001` at `+0x1C`, `ecx` at dword `+0x28` and `r8d` at dword `+0x30`, then calls `00361030` with `ecx` and ORs 2 into byte `+2` of its result when that is non-null; a negative `ecx` or a null record skips everything after the divide
